args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Rollback**: checkout-api was failing health checks on v2.3.1 (the latest deploy). I rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production, and the rollback was verified.

2. **Incident**: Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the health check failures on v2.3.1 and the rollback mitigation to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so the root cause of its health check failures still needs investigation by the on-call engineer.
